interpretations.business_scale: DeepMind cannot be analyzed like a private company because its economics are embedded inside Alphabet.
interpretations.customer_adoption: Adoption should be read through Google distribution and Cloud integration rather than standalone customer counts.
interpretations.model_product: Google DeepMind remains a core frontier-model competitor with strong multimodal and infrastructure backing.
interpretations.infrastructure: Infrastructure is a major advantage because Google controls cloud and TPU capacity.
interpretations.capital: Funding risk is lower than private labs, but capex intensity is absorbed at Alphabet scale.
interpretations.valuation: Standalone valuation analysis is not meaningful.
interpretations.competition: DeepMind is differentiated by distribution, infrastructure, and research depth.

strengthen: Gemini gains developer and enterprise share
Google Search and Workspace AI features improve monetization
weaken: Developer mindshare shifts to OpenAI or Anthropic
final_interpretation: Google DeepMind is a frontier AI organization embedded in Alphabet rather than a standalone private AI company. Its thesis rests on model quality, Google distribution, cloud infrastructure, and integration into core products.
